title: Active sessions currently waiting
description: Return active sessions lasting at least 60 seconds whose wait_event is not NULL. Return exactly four columns: session_id, database_name, duration_sec, wait_event. Sort by duration_sec DESC, then session_id ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT session_id, database_name, duration_sec, wait_event
FROM sessions
hints: State, minimum duration, and the presence of wait_event are all required.
NULL is tested with a dedicated SQL predicate.
solution_explanation: A session without wait_event is not considered waiting even if it is long-running and active.
